step_semantics.order: synaptic current from previous fired * gain; v*=decay; v+=current+tonic; v+=noise; optional eye; inject; refractory; fire if v>=1; reset fired to 0; record last_spike; steps++
step_semantics.v_units: dimensionless model units, not mV; threshold exactly 1.0; no mV conversion in source
step_semantics.tonic_rescaling: in __init__, tonic is rescaled by (1-exp(-dt/tau))/(1-exp(-0.020/tau)); at dt=0.020 it stays 0.14

noise.mechanism: per-step Bernoulli mask rng.random((n,batch)) < hz*dt, add amp; not Gaussian

inject.index_space: flat global neuron row indices into v
inject.unit: voltage increment in the same dimensionless v units; not nA

spike.order: fire indices from v>=1, then v.ravel()[fired]=0; pre-reset v is not stored

synaptic_weights.orientation: W[post, pre]; CPU CSC columns are presynaptic; _propagate sums outgoing weights of fired neurons into postsynaptic rows
synaptic_weights.sign: signed float32 weights; no abs/clipping in step
synaptic_weights.normalization: none in step; weights loaded directly; aggregate multiplied by gain=3.0
synaptic_weights.units: dimensionless model units, not nA or conductance

step_semantics.rng_reset: reset(seed) zeroes v and sets default_rng(seed); S3 run_condition calls reset(seed) for every condition, so sham/low/primary use the same noise stream across 400 steps

indirect_feedback.note: static reachability only; longer paths not exhaustively enumerated; no dynamics

static_math.formula: v_inf = (tonic + a)/(1-exp(-dt/tau)); no synaptic/no noise/no spike/reset
static_math.caveat: This is a no-spike/no-noise/no-synaptic fixed point; it does not predict firing-rate increment. Threshold 1.0 is above all three fixed points; noise/spikes/network can change outcomes.

biological_evidence.biological_basis: not calibrated here; source cites ornata/fly64 comparison, not measured fly membrane

biological_evidence.not_supported: mV threshold or biological spike threshold

biological_evidence.biological_basis: source docstring explicitly says hand-calibrated, not measured

biological_evidence.source_assumption: official connectome weights, signed; no normalization in step
biological_evidence.biological_basis: anatomical connectivity only; sign/magnitude not physiological calibration
biological_evidence.not_supported: synaptic current/conductance or biological sign/magnitude claim

api_access.v_after_step: brain.v is readable after step (post-reset for fired cells)
api_access.pre_reset_v: not stored; lost for fired cells
api_access.component_breakdown: step does not store leak/synaptic/tonic/noise/inject components
api_access.synaptic_input: brain.synaptic_input(brain.fired) can recompute aggregate synaptic current for the last fired set; no component history
api_access.proposed: subclass/wrapper of FlyBrain.step or a small callback copy that logs target KC/MBON (and preselected relays): v before, v after leak/tonic, synaptic current, noise sample, inject, v pre-threshold, v post-reset, fired, threshold distance

answers.q1_lif_vs_prereg: YES at code level: the S3 injection amount is a direct voltage increment, and the static formula matches the frozen amount; this does not validate biological current semantics.
answers.q2_biological_parameters: NO validated biological calibration for threshold/reset/tonic/gain/noise/tau; W is anatomical structure only. Source says tonic/gain/noise are hand-calibrated, not measured.
answers.q3_s3_evidence: S3 proves a significant model-internal KC rate increase (+0.022858) under direct voltage, and low/primary ratio 0.508873; it cannot prove natural sensory drive, biological current equivalence, single-synapse causality, or downstream MBON function.
answers.q4_reliable_voltage_logging: The current API alone is insufficient for pre-reset/component traces; a small-memory instrumented step is feasible and should be validated before any new full run.
answers.q5_next: B first: pause stronger stimulation and validate model/biological-drive semantics with voltage/current instrumentation; only then pre-register a new dose study.

decision.reason: Direct voltage injection and hand-calibrated dynamics; observed weak rate increment cannot be interpreted as biological dose response without voltage/current traces.
decision.do_not: Do not change dose, rerun S3, or extrapolate stronger stimulation; no new full-brain authorization.
